measurement_notes: Pairs are [feature-off, feature-on]; code extents are half-open; reserved ranges are [start,length].
Timings are one release-profile sample per configuration, with other qualification processes running; no speedup claim.
Extra emission passes are the selected control-flow count in the reducer; no per-site full materialization trials.
Mapped storage bytes sum symbol sizes and can include overlapping aliases; this is not a union of physical memory.
Frame hashes include all ordinary homes, spills and zero-page allocation facts; detailed frames and symbols are in ignored measurement JSON files.
Zero page covers declared/allocated/source-mapped cells and excludes implicit runtime-only helper scratch.
Pre-home admission checks every direct-call shape after existing producer forwarding; late counters describe only the reconstructed template.
